scheduling-resources.scope: Distinguish a Pod create rejection from a suspended queued Job and a submitted Pod with no binding.
scheduling-resources.observation: Cloud reaches the same native queue experiment from its existing kind scheduling lab.

training-platform.scope: Attach queue and node waiting to separate objects of the same Job.
training-platform.observation: The lifecycle now links to native Kueue, Kubernetes binding and real indexed CPU outputs.

gpu-scheduling.scope: Trace native Kueue reservation, actual node placement, and indexed application output through a single Job.
gpu-scheduling.observation: A 200m holder delays the target. After holder completion two 100m Pods remain unscheduled, then the same Pod UIDs bind following a node-label intervention and output 37 and 12.

kubernetes-training.scope: Connect Indexed Job completion identities to native results before training-process rendezvous.
kubernetes-training.observation: Both completed CPU indices are verified, with fixed communication-group and physical-host boundaries remaining separate.
